review.ambient_and_spherical_identities: H4=B^2-s A/2+s^2/12 is harmonic in R4; Y^2=H4+Z2/2+1/6. Unit-S3 eigenvalues are -8 and -24. Both direct tangential projection and Laplace product rule give |grad Y|^2=4/3+2Z2-4H4. Normalized mean Y^2=1/6 and gradient square=4/3; physical angular contractions require R^-2.
review.angular_completeness: The Spin(4) symmetric-square character independently agrees with (0,0)+(1,1)+(2,2)+(2,0)+(0,2), dimensions 1+9+25+5+5=45. The no-forced-coexact-vector statement is qualified by a single aligned mode and equivariant first reconstruction. Scalar identities are not presented as full tensor projections.
review.bulk_convention: The physical residual R_AB-phi_A phi_B-(2/3)V g_AB and scalar Box phi-Vprime match the prior full-contact model. U2 is a second parameter derivative, so L U2=-D2F[U1,U1] has no extra factor one-half. A reduced-gauge calculation must differentiate the same reduced residual, including quadratic gauge terms.
review.junction_convention: Two outward normals are summed with one common tension. The trace-reversed coefficient is sigma h/3, giving sigma h/6 on each identical copy and n phi=-sigma_prime/2. Both displayed second metric and scalar junction rows match the retained material junction equations exactly.
review.prior_results_retained: The opening and implementation sections expressly retain the previously constructed conditional complete finite-angular second Taylor coefficient through contact and the angular-uniform frozen-linear/control and local boundary-reduction results. Earlier finite-regularity exact initial/precontact families and later conditional exact-family results retain their own gauge, inverse, support, regularity and lifespan hypotheses. No identification of distinct second corrections is silently assumed.
review.quantitative_target: The actual wider-state quadratic source/projection table, quantitative U2, material shell stress and proper-time response, and nonlinear error estimate remain future work. Free second-order homogeneous initial data and the necessary clock/gauge matching are explicitly required.
review.stress_and_pullback: The material pure-tension stress second derivative retains sigma0 h2, sigma_prime psi2 h0, twice the mixed psi1 h1 term, and sigma_second psi1 squared h0 with their negative signs. The pullback formula uses the derivative of the parameter generator, not unqualified coordinate acceleration, and retains the noncommuting Lie-square term. Tensor traces use the varying inverse metric.
